passive.en: Heartfelt Caress: When the equipper's HP decreases, their Ice Sheer DMG increases by {{value}}%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 25s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. When the equipper's HP falls to 50% of Max HP or below, CRIT Rate increases by {{value}}%.

Cloud Flow: CRIT Rate increases by {{value}}%. When the equipper launches an EX Special Attack, the character gains the Qingming Companion effect, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 15s. On entering combat, immediately gain 2 stacks. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of the Qingming Companion effect increases the equipper's Ether DMG by {{value}}%, and increases Ultimate and EX Special Attack Ether Sheer DMG by {{value}}%.

Knight's Morale: Increases CRIT Rate by 20%. When the equipper launches a Special Attack, their Physical Sheer DMG increases by 10%, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

Purging Karmic Fire: CRIT Rate increases by {{value}}%. When the equipper launches an EX Special Attack, their Fire Sheer DMG increases by {{value}}%, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 20s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

Summoning Arcanum: When the equipper activates an EX Special Attack, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's DMG by {{value}}%, up to 3 stacks, and lasting 20s. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. At 3 stacks, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by {{value}}%.
Caged Fire: The equipper's Fire DMG increases by {{value}}%. When the equipper's HP decreases, their CRIT Rate increases by {{value}}% for 5s.

Ingenious Craft: Upon launching an EX Special Attack, the equipper's CRIT DMG increases by {{value}}% for 12s. Additionally, if the target's current HP is below 50% of their Max HP, EX Special Attack DMG increases by {{value}}%.

Easy Strides: When launching a Chain Attack or Ultimate, the equipper gains 1 stack of a buff effect. Each stack increases the equipper's Sheer Force by {{value}}, stacking up to 3 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
Dim Flame: Upon entering combat or switching in, the equipper's ATK increases by {{value}}% for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s.
